risks.risk: Battery/charger health and charging function not confirmed.

risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested (worst-case: assume possible faults until proven).

Close-up photos of the lens model markings and the lens glass (front element and any visible fungus/scratches).
Photo/video showing the charger indicator while charging, and camera power-on using each of the two batteries.
